definitions.explanation: A person or people with skills and abilities needed for a particular role. Also refers collectively to human resources within an organization.

examples.japanese: {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい}を{求|もと}めている。
examples.english: We are looking for talented people.

examples.japanese: {人材|じんざい}の{育成|いくせい}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: We are putting effort into developing talent.

examples.japanese: IT{分野|ぶんや}では{人材|じんざい}{不足|ぶそく}が{深刻|しんこく}な{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: In the IT field, a shortage of talent has become a serious problem.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人材|じんざい}を{育成|いくせい}する (to develop talent)
- {人材|じんざい}を{確保|かくほ}する (to secure talent)
- {人材|じんざい}{不足|ぶそく} (talent shortage)
- {人材|じんざい}{派遣|はけん} (staffing, temporary staffing)
- {人材|じんざい}{紹介|しょうかい} (recruitment, headhunting)
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい} (excellent talent)

The variant {人財|じんざい} (using {財|ざい} meaning "treasure") is sometimes used by companies to emphasize that people are valuable assets.
